race.title: Midnite Built Different Handicap
race.verdict: GOT THE BOOTY has quickly found her feet for Clive Cox so she's fancied to go one better than on her last couple of starts with first-time cheekpieces applied. Nogo's Dream went close at Wolverhampton on penultimate start and having shaped as if still in good form in the mud at Bath since, he's put forward as the main threat. Magna may prove best of the rest. GOT THE BOOTY (FR) NOGO'S DREAM MAGNA
